name: Mel Mel Melty Märchen
original_name: メル・メル メルティーメルヘン
source:
Classic western fairy-tales return adapted for adult taste, but to get to adult part it's needed to to write what's shown with sign language.

It is practically a Japanese sign language trainer with erotic graphics as rewards.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
经典的西方童话故事回归，适应成人的口味，但要达到成人的部分，需要用手语来书写所展示的内容。

它实际上是一个日本手语训练师，以色情图形作为奖励。

[编辑自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
